Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

opīnor

opīnor, opīnārī, opīnātus sum

verb, first conjugation, deponent

believe, suppose; opīnor in passing, “I believe”; probably; I suppose, I think; think, suppose

In this lexicon

  • believe

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.92: nōndum, opīnor, est experrēctus; Traupman 109: Sīc opīnor.

  • probably

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.92: nōndum, opīnor, est experrēctus; Cic. Att. 9.6.2: sed, opīnor, quiēscāmus; Gell. 2.22.20: ā turbine, opīnor, ejus ac vertīgine

  • think

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.92: nōndum, opīnor, est experrēctus

  • Sīc opīnor.: I think so

    classical

Examples

  • nōndum, opīnor, est experrēctus

    he probably hasn’t woken up yetCic. Tusc. 1.92

    since you came by ship, you were probably frightened.Plaut. Bacch. 106
